5929-6991-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5929-6991-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Leyline of Transformation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

862-5006-5686-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crimson Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
862-5006-5686-8170.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crimson Kobolds spell. Then, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

3025-4279-4314--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3025-4279-4314--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2645-3230-3430-7014.easyPrerequisites: North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3230-3430-7014.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2178-2380-2921.easyPrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
2178-2380-2921.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

2866-4986-5034-6495.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sol Ring.
When Sol Ring leaves the battlefield, Scrap Trawler triggers, returning any mana value 0 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2866-4986-5034-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2557-6664-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

6575-7063.description:
Cast Ember Island Production by paying {3}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Esper Terra that isn't legendary and will enter with a lore counter on it.
When the Esper Terra token enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of itself with haste and four lore counters on it.
When the Esper Terra token enters the battlefield, its first, second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first and second trigger, creating token copies of any nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and exile the Esper Terra token.
Resolve the third trigger, creating a token copy of the Esper Terra token created in step 2 with haste and four lore counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

1429-4659-6982.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Repeat.

1770-3821-4770.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}.
1770-3821-4770.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3532-4997-5078-7692.easyPrerequisites: You control another Merfolk or Knight.
3532-4997-5078-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Merfolk and Knight you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

141-3125-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in your graveyard.
141-3125-4050.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Victimize.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Naru Meha and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

140-6734-7433.description:
Activate Shadowcloak Vampire by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2049-3259-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2049-3259-6965.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2292-4559-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
2292-4559-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2292-4559-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2438-4605-4681-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-3263-7132.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's first ability by paying {3}, creating a 0/3 Wall creature token with defender.
When the Wall enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Wall you control.
Repeat.
2440-3263-7132.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use it to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.

414-4613-5805.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
414-4613-5805.description:
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
The Insect enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev, causing it to have Grist's abilities.
Repeat from step 1 using the Insect token instead.

413-862-4053-6989.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
When Crimson Kobolds enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2866-4659-4708-4986.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2173-2448-5220-6094.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-5220-6094.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1987-4002-4423-5243.easyPrerequisites:
You control three additional Islands.
You control three or more lands that share a name.
1987-4002-4423-5243.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping them, adding {3}{U}
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

907-5449-5478-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
907-5449-5478-5702.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters untapped due to Spelunking, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

907-4572-5702-6664.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
907-4572-5702-6664.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1796-2438-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
1796-2438-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
1796-2438-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

856-997-4321-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-997-4321-5631.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

856-2511-4321-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2511-4321-5632.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token, Clue token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2525-3358-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2525-3358-4068.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

698-2450-3152.easyPrerequisites: Will, Scion of Peace does not have summoning sickness.
698-2450-3152.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained 2 or more life this turn.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
698-2450-3152.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, causing white and blue spells you cast this turn to cost at least {2} less.
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {U}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Resolve Whim of Volrath.
Repeat from step 2.

1288-3259-6096.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Goblin.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1288-3259-6096.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Goblin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
General Kreat's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
When the Goblin enters the battlefield, General Kreat's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Goblin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3967-5805--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
3967-5805--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with persist.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, as well as a +1/+1 counter due to Gev.
The +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters on that creature are removed as a state-based action.
Resolve the ability from step 1, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

624-2511-5011.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

969-1170-1328-4251.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any Samurai you control.
969-1170-1328-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Godo.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

2459-3410-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {U/B}.
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary and Kels trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Rograkh on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Kels trigger, causing you to pay {U/B} to draw Rograkh from the top of your library.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1786-3260-4691.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 5.
1786-3260-4691.description:
Activate Vilis by paying 4 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw four cards.
Queza triggers four times, causing you to gain four life and target opponent to lose four life.
Resolve the Vilis ability, giving a creature -1/-1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

541-2103-3634-3879.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one and exiling it due to rebound.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, rebound triggers, causing you to cast the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Activate Portal of Sanctuary by tapping it and paying {1}, returning Venser to your hand.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, they trigger, returning the extra turn spell to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

575-1317-4489.description:
Cast Protean Hydra for {X} = 0.
Protean Hydra dies due to having zero toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning it to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate that Forest adding {G}.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face-down Protean Hydra, and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.

618-1990-2240.description:
Cast Worldly Tutor by paying {G}, putting Kiki-Jiki on top of your library.
Activate Conspicuous Snoop's ability from Kiki-Jiki, creating a token copy of Conspicuous Snoop.
Activate the token Conspicuous Snoop's ability from Kiki-Jiki, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat the last step any number of times.

92-4624.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total or are tied for the highest life total.
92-4624.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Cast Revenge by paying {4}{W}{B}, doubling your life total and causing target opponent to lose half their life, rounded up.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
